description: SIM99 v3 — RIFT Galaxy Rotation Curves. Shooting method (inward from r_max) selects physical decaying Yukawa halo mode. V(Psi)=(lambda_gal/4)*Psi^4 added as simplest nonlinear extension consistent with V'(0)=0 (no constant background). Tests whether ANY (Psi_bc, lambda_gal) within cosmological bounds produces flat rotation curves.

NGC3198.note: Classic flat-curve spiral. Freeman disk + HI gas. de Blok+ 2008.

verdict.definition: PASS if v_c(r) within +/-20% of v_flat for r > 0.5*r_max, AND Lambda0*Psi^2 < cosmo bound everywhere, AND rho_Psi >= 0 everywhere.
